skillFull: Starts running with a Sugar Shield protecting against one collision, and revives the Cookie once. Level Up for more Energy on revival.
story: Nectar Delight bloomed from fragments of memories. It is unknown which memories the Pet appeared from. But one thing is for certain, these memories were born of pure light and warmth. Sugar Glass Cookie takes extra special care of Nectar Delight, never wishing to see a single petal wither for even a moment.
